about_project_text: Wow Forever Codex aims to bring together everything players need for their World of Warcraft Forever adventure in one place, without jumping between multiple sites. The site evolves with the game and content may change during the beta.
about_data_text: Once available, the site will rely on Blizzard's official APIs to display reliable, up-to-date information.

races_subtitle: Compare the racial abilities of every WoW Forever race and faction.
races_compare_hint: Select at least two races to compare them side by side.
races_data_source: Data read from the WoW Forever client (build {build}, updated {date}). It may change during the beta.
racial_human_perception_description: Greatly increases your Stealth Detection for 20 sec.
racial_human_ruthlessness_description: Increases your spell and attack critical strike chance by 1%.
racial_human_mace_specialization_descrip: Mace and Two-Handed Mace skill increased by 5.
racial_human_sword_specialization_descri: Sword and Two-Handed Sword skill increased by 5.
racial_dwarf_find_treasure_description: Allows the dwarf to detect nearby treasure and display it on the minimap. Lasts until cancelled.
racial_dwarf_stoneform_description: Instantly removes all bleed, poison and disease effects, makes you immune to those effect types and reduces all physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec.
racial_dwarf_stoneform_classic: While active, you are immune to bleed, poison and disease effects. Armor is also increased by 10%. Lasts 8 sec.
racial_dwarf_big_game_hunter_description: Increases damage dealt to beasts by 5%.
racial_dwarf_artisans_precision_descript: Increases your critical strike bonus to damage and healing by 2%.
racial_night_elf_elunes_light_descriptio: Increases your spell and attack critical strike chance by 10% for 15 sec.
racial_night_elf_shadowmeld_description: Activate to blend into the shadows, reducing the chance enemies detect your presence. Lasts until you cancel it or move. Used in combat, it dissuades enemies from attacking you, but its cooldown becomes 2 min.
racial_night_elf_shadowmeld_classic: Activate to blend into the shadows, reducing the chance enemies detect your presence. Lasts until you cancel it or move. Night elf rogues and druids with the Shadowmeld racial are harder to spot when using their stealth abilities.
racial_night_elf_quickness_description: Increases dodge chance by 1% and movement speed by 2%. Night elf rogues and druids are harder to detect while stealthed, as if they were 1 level higher.
racial_night_elf_wisp_spirit_description: Transforms you into a wisp upon death, increasing your movement speed by 75%.
racial_night_elf_wisp_spirit_classic: Transforms you into a wisp upon death, increasing movement speed by 50%.
racial_gnome_escape_artist_description: Instantly frees you from movement-impairing effects and makes you immune to them for 3 sec.
racial_gnome_escape_artist_classic: Frees you from immobilizing and movement-slowing effects. 1 min cooldown.
racial_gnome_eureka_description: For 8 sec, the resource cost of your damaging abilities (or healing ones, depending on the class) is reduced by 10% and their effects are increased by 10%. The resource depends on the class: energy, mana or rage. Periodic effects are excluded for most classes.
racial_gnome_engineering_specialization_: Your gnomish ingenuity reduces the failures and backfires of the engineering devices you use by 20%.
racial_gnome_expansive_mind_description: Increases your maximum mana, energy or rage by 5%, depending on your class resource.
racial_high_order_skyborne_read_leyline_: You attempt to tap into the power of a nearby leyline, increasing your health and mana regeneration by 50% for 15 sec. Cast on a leyline, it also grants Attuned for 1 hour, which raises this bonus to 100%. Attuned persists through death and is removed when you enter a raid. Cannot be used while Innervate is active.
racial_high_order_skyborne_walk_on_air_d: You glide through the air, steadily losing altitude for 10 sec while keeping control of your trajectory.
racial_high_order_skyborne_elemental_kno: Damage dealt to elementals increased by 5%.
racial_high_order_skyborne_blessing_of_t: Increases melee, ranged and spell Haste by 2%.
racial_orc_blood_fury_description: Increases attack power and spell power by 10% for 15 sec.
racial_orc_blood_fury_classic: Increases base melee attack power by 25% for 15 sec and reduces the effects of healing on you by 50% for 25 sec.
racial_orc_curse_breaker_description: Instantly removes all curses and plagues, and reduces magic damage taken by 5% for 8 sec.
racial_orc_hardiness_description: Reduces the duration of stun effects on you by 20%.
racial_orc_hardiness_classic: Chance to resist stun effects increased by 25%.
racial_orc_savage_description: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and abilities by 1%.
racial_orc_command_description: Damage dealt by hunter and warlock pets increased by 5%.
racial_orc_axe_specialization_descriptio: Axe and Two-Handed Axe skill increased by 5.
racial_undead_cannibalize_description: When activated, restores 7% of your total health and 7% of your total mana every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on humanoid or undead corpses within 5 yards. Any movement, action or damage taken while cannibalizing cancels the effect.
racial_undead_cannibalize_classic: When activated, restores 7% of total health every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on undead and humanoid corpses within 5 yards. Moving or being attacked cancels the effect.
racial_undead_will_of_the_forsaken_descr: Instantly removes all charm, fear and sleep effects.
racial_undead_will_of_the_forsaken_class: While active, makes you immune to Charm, Fear and Sleep effects. Can be used even while already affected by one. Lasts 5 sec.
racial_undead_touch_of_the_grave_descrip: Your spells and attacks have a 20 to 30% chance (depending on the ability version) to drain health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum health. 15 sec internal cooldown.
racial_undead_underwater_breathing_descr: Underwater breathing duration is 300% longer than normal.
racial_tauren_cultivation_description: You cultivate a nearby herb and create a duplicate you can gather without the Herbalism skill. Each herb can only be cultivated once.
racial_tauren_war_stomp_description: Stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yards for 2 sec.
racial_tauren_war_stomp_classic: Stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yards for 2 sec. 2 min cooldown.
racial_tauren_plainsrunning_description: You gain a 2% movement speed bonus for every 5 sec spent moving, up to a maximum bonus of 60%. The effect decreases if you take damage or stand still. Does not increase mounted speed.
racial_troll_berserking_description: Increases your spell casting speed and attack speed by 10% for 10 sec.
racial_troll_berserking_classic: Increases your casting and attack speed by 10% to 30%. At full health the increase is 10%, with a larger effect of up to 30% if you are badly wounded when activating. Lasts 10 sec.
racial_troll_rapid_regeneration_descript: You recover 50% of your maximum health over 6 sec. Any movement, action or damage taken cancels the effect.
racial_troll_beast_slaying_description: Increases damage dealt to beasts by 5%.
racial_troll_regeneration_description: Health regeneration rate increased by 20%. In addition, 20% of health regeneration remains active during combat.
racial_troll_regeneration_classic: Health regeneration rate increased by 10%. 10% of health regeneration remains active during combat.
racial_windshaper_skyborne_skysight_desc: You attempt to tap into the power of an elemental convergence and receive its blessing, increasing your movement speed and your mount's by 15% for 15 sec. Cast on an elemental convergence, it also grants Charged for 1 hour, which raises this bonus to 30%. Charged persists through death and is removed when you enter a raid.
racial_windshaper_skyborne_walk_on_air_d: You glide through the air, steadily losing altitude for 10 sec while keeping control of your trajectory.
racial_windshaper_skyborne_elemental_kno: Damage dealt to elementals increased by 5%.
racial_windshaper_skyborne_blessing_of_t: Increases melee, ranged and spell Haste by 2%.
